channel.title: The Barons of Orzelbirg
channel.description: The players' podcast for the Irregulars: the barony's rules, lore and people, some of it read by the court itself.
channel.itunes:summary: The players' podcast for the Irregulars: the barony's rules, lore and people, some of it read by the court itself.
channel.itunes:author: The Irregulars

item.title: 1. The Book So Far
item.description: Read by Emeryk Lis, Clerk of the Court. The Clerk reads the Book of Orzelbirg from its first page: the road that brought you here, the First Court, and the night on the Pale Road.
item.itunes:summary: Read by Emeryk Lis, Clerk of the Court. The Clerk reads the Book of Orzelbirg from its first page: the road that brought you here, the First Court, and the night on the Pale Road.

item.title: 2. The Barony's Sheet
item.description: The rules, plainly. What's on the Barony's Sheet: the barony's skills, defenses and tracks, the power dice, the Clerk's other books, and the table's rulings.
item.itunes:summary: The rules, plainly. What's on the Barony's Sheet: the barony's skills, defenses and tracks, the power dice, the Clerk's other books, and the table's rulings.

item.title: 3. The Barony's Week
item.description: The rules, plainly. How the barony gets things done between games: the five moves, whose turn, the first slate, and calling the barony to arms.
item.itunes:summary: The rules, plainly. How the barony gets things done between games: the five moves, whose turn, the first slate, and calling the barony to arms.

item.title: 4. Ten Villages and a Broken Wall
item.description: Told by Stefan Borislav, Steward of Orzelbirg. The Steward walks you round the barony and the castle, and reads you the accounts.
item.itunes:summary: Told by Stefan Borislav, Steward of Orzelbirg. The Steward walks you round the barony and the castle, and reads you the accounts.

item.title: 5. How Morgau Answers
item.description: The rules, plainly. Exposure and Honor: how Morgau squeezes a barony that defies it, and what the Crown and the Slahta say of you.
item.itunes:summary: The rules, plainly. Exposure and Honor: how Morgau squeezes a barony that defies it, and what the Crown and the Slahta say of you.

item.title: 6. The Old Law
item.description: Told by Sister Aniela Radosz, counsel to the court. Sister Aniela reads the Statutes of Krakova, with the notes she keeps in the margins.

item.title: 7. Your Seat
item.description: The rules, plainly. The offices of the court: each seat's duty in court, its title, its insignia, and the barony work it leads.
item.itunes:summary: The rules, plainly. The offices of the court: each seat's duty in court, its title, its insignia, and the barony work it leads.

item.title: 8. Names at the High Table
